q: ___我在开会，没接电话。
en: I was in a meeting a moment ago and did not answer the phone.

q: ___谁给我打电话了？
en: Who called me a moment ago?

q: 你___去哪儿了？我找了你很久。
en: Where did you go just now? I looked for you for ages.

q: ___经理叫你去办公室，你不在。
en: The manager asked for you at his office a moment ago, but you were not in.

q: ___医生来看你，你在睡觉。
en: The doctor came to see you a moment ago while you were asleep.

q: ___会议室里的空调坏了，大家都热得受不了，现在已经修好了。
en: A moment ago the air conditioning in the meeting room broke and everyone was unbearably hot; it has been fixed now.

q: ___我的头很疼，现在好一点儿了。
en: My head hurt a lot a moment ago, but it is a little better now.

q: ___老板在会上说的话，大家都听清楚了。
en: Everyone heard clearly what the boss said at the meeting just now.

q: ___的电话是谁打的？
en: Who was that phone call from just now?

q: 你还记得___那个人吗？
en: Do you still remember the person from just now?

q: 我的头现在比___好多了。
en: My head is much better now than a moment ago.

q: 你别把___的事告诉经理。
en: Do not tell the manager what happened just now.

q: 这个房间比___凉快多了。
en: This room is much cooler than it was a moment ago.

q: 你能再说一遍___医生说的话吗？
en: Could you repeat what the doctor said just now?

q: ___那封邮件是谁发来的？
en: Who sent that email from a moment ago?

q: 我觉得这个方案比___那个方案更合适。
en: I think this plan is more suitable than the one from a moment ago.

q: 医生说我的体温跟___一样高，还得再观察一会儿。
en: The doctor said my temperature is as high as it was a moment ago and that I need to be watched a little longer.

q: ___的会议记录你整理好了吗？
en: Have you tidied up the minutes of the meeting we just had?

q: 你___为什么不告诉我？
en: Why did you not tell me just now?

q: ___他不在办公室，现在回来了。
en: He was not in the office a moment ago; he is back now.

q: 你___怎么没接电话？
en: Why did you not answer the phone just now?

q: 我___没带手机，所以没看到你的信息。
en: I did not have my phone with me a moment ago, so I did not see your message.

q: 护士___不让我喝水，现在可以了。
en: The nurse would not let me drink water a moment ago, but now I can.

q: 我___头不疼，怎么现在突然疼起来了？
en: My head did not hurt a moment ago; why does it suddenly hurt now?

q: 你___没吃药吗？医生让你饭后马上吃。
en: Did you not take your medicine just now? The doctor told you to take it right after eating.

q: 老板___不同意这个计划，怎么现在又改变主意了？
en: The boss did not agree to this plan a moment ago; how come he has changed his mind now?

q: 我___一直没听清楚你说的话，因为旁边的人声音太大了。
en: I could not hear clearly what you were saying a moment ago because the people next to us were too loud.

q: 他___不舒服，没去吃午饭，现在好多了。
en: He was not feeling well a moment ago and did not go to lunch; he is much better now.

q: 我___来两天，还不认识路。
en: I have only been here for two days and I do not know the way yet.

q: 他___学了三个月汉语。
en: He has only been studying Chinese for three months.

q: 我们___认识一个星期。
en: We have only known each other for a week.

q: 我___在这家公司工作了半年，还不太熟悉工作。
en: I have only been working at this company for half a year and I am still not very familiar with the work.

q: 我___感冒两天，不用去医院吧？
en: I have only had a cold for two days; I do not need to go to the hospital, do I?

q: 小王___上班一个星期，很多事情还不会做。
en: Xiao Wang has only been at work for a week and cannot do many things yet.

q: 这位病人___住院三天，医生还需要继续观察。
en: This patient has only been in hospital for three days and the doctor still needs to keep observing him.

q: 我___锻炼了一个月，腿还是有点儿疼。
en: I have only been working out for a month and my legs still hurt a bit.

q: 我们公司___成立两年，需要更多的时间来发展。
en: Our company has only been set up for two years and needs more time to develop.

q: 他___走了，你没看见吗？
en: He left a moment ago; did you not see?

q: 我___下班，还没吃饭。
en: I have only just got off work and have not eaten yet.

q: ___他去洗手间了，现在回来了。
en: He went to the washroom a moment ago; he is back now.

q: 我___吃完药，一会儿再喝水。
en: I have just finished taking my medicine; I will drink water in a while.

q: 经理___出去，你五分钟后再来吧。
en: The manager has just gone out; come back in five minutes.

q: 我___起床，还没洗脸。
en: I have only just got up and have not washed my face yet.

q: 客户___还在这儿，现在已经走了。
en: The client was still here a moment ago; he has already left now.

q: 病人___醒过来，现在还不能说话。
en: The patient has only just come round and cannot speak yet.

q: 你___说什么了？我没听清。
en: What did you say just now? I did not catch it.

q: 她___睡着，别吵醒她。
en: She has only just fallen asleep; do not wake her.

q: 我___到公司，经理就找我了。
en: I had only just got to the office when the manager came looking for me.

q: 他___坐下，电话就响了。
en: He had only just sat down when the phone rang.

q: 他___打开电脑，老板就叫他去开会。
en: He had only just turned on the computer when the boss called him to a meeting.

q: 我___坐下，经理___进来了。
en: I had no sooner sat down than the manager came in.

q: 护士___给我量完体温，医生___来了。
en: The nurse had only just finished taking my temperature when the doctor came.

q: 我___想给你发邮件，你的邮件就到了。
en: I was just about to email you when your email arrived.

q: 我___躺下，手机就响了，是公司打来的。
en: I had only just lain down when my phone rang; it was the office calling.

q: 他___做完手术，还没完全醒过来，家人就都赶到了医院。
en: He had only just come out of surgery and had not fully woken up when his family all rushed to the hospital.

q: 会议___开始，客户就提出了一个很难回答的问题。
en: The meeting had only just started when the client raised a very hard question.

q: 他去年___毕业，现在在公司工作。
en: He only graduated last year and now works at a company.

q: 这台电脑是我昨天___买的。
en: I only bought this computer yesterday.

q: 我今天早上___到北京。
en: I only arrived in Beijing this morning.

q: 她上个月___来公司，还不认识大家。
en: She only joined the company last month and does not know everyone yet.

q: 我们上星期___开始用这个软件，还不太熟悉。
en: We only started using this software last week and are not very familiar with it yet.

q: 我上周___发现自己的血压有点儿高，医生让我少吃盐。
en: I only found out last week that my blood pressure is a little high, and the doctor told me to eat less salt.

q: 他三年前___开始跑步，现在每天都跑。
en: He had only just started running three years ago; now he runs every day.

q: 我今天上午___参加完一个会议，下午还有两个等着我。
en: I only finished one meeting this morning, and two more are waiting for me this afternoon.

q: 这位医生去年___从国外回来，所以对这里的医院还不太了解。
en: This doctor only came back from abroad last year, so he does not know the hospitals here very well yet.
